baseline.instructions: Was the text in `text` mostly generated by an AI system rather than written by a person? Judge the writing as presented, including its wording, structure, and level of authorship. Minor spelling, grammar, or editing assistance does not count as mostly AI-generated. If the text contains quotations, copied excerpts, or parent-context wording, do not silently attribute that material to the post author; judge authorship from the author's own prose in `text` only. Never use `quoted_text` as evidence of the author's AI usage.

criteria.true: The majority of the authored text appears to have been generated by an AI system.
criteria.false: The text appears mostly human-written, or any AI assistance appears limited to editing, polishing, or isolated suggestions.

concise_guarded.instructions: Was most of the wording in `text` written or substantially rewritten by a generative AI? Personal experiences may be real even when the wording is AI-generated. Exclude minor spelling and grammar corrections. Judge the author's own prose; exclude quoted excerpts and `quoted_text`.

instructions.question: Did a generative AI compose most of the final wording of the author's own prose in `text`?
instructions.scope: Ignore `quoted_text` and quoted or copied material attributed to others. Judge authorship of wording, not truth of the story.
counts_as_ai: A person gives ChatGPT personal facts and asks it to write a Reddit post.
A person gives a rough draft and an AI substantially rewrites the sentences and organization.
An AI writes advice, a story, or an opinion in a casual first-person voice.
does_not_count: A person writes the prose and uses minor spelling or grammar correction.
A person independently uses headings, lists, polished grammar, or common expressions.
A person discusses or quotes AI output while writing their own commentary.

criteria.true: AI composed most final wording, from scratch or through substantial rewriting.
criteria.false: A person composed most final wording, with at most minor AI proofreading.

chatgpt_wording.instructions: Does the author's own prose in `text` appear to have been composed by ChatGPT or another large language model? Count an AI-written Reddit post based on real human experiences or instructions. Exclude minor proofreading, attributed quotations, and `quoted_text`. Formatting, correctness, and politeness alone do not establish AI authorship.

criteria.true: Most wording appears composed by a language model.
criteria.false: Most wording appears composed by a person.

authorship_choice.instructions: Which origin best explains the final wording of the author's own prose in `text`? Personal experiences can be real under either origin. Ignore quoted excerpts and `quoted_text`.

criteria.human: A person composed most wording; at most minor AI spelling or grammar correction.
criteria.ai: A generative AI composed most wording, either from instructions or by substantially rewriting human-provided facts or a rough draft.

artifact_aware.instructions: Was most of the author's own prose in `text` generated or substantially rewritten by AI? Count AI writing based on real personal experiences. Strong evidence includes unquoted assistant preambles offering a requested draft, model self-identification, or leftover response instructions presented as the post itself. Weigh stylistic patterns together; lists, polished grammar, and common phrases alone are insufficient. Exclude minor proofreading and AI material quoted or discussed by a human author. Never use `quoted_text` as authorship evidence.
